title: Inter's problem isn't the attack — 3 scored, 4 conceded against Club Brugge
caption:
Inter scored three at San Siro and still lost 3-4 to Club Brugge, per Inter.it — Nicolò Tresoldi scored a hat trick and Inter have no points from their first two Champions League matches. Goal Italia gave Josep Martínez 5/10 for the second goal. The problem isn't up front.
